Subject: Intro 20m call — DST-friendly slots, weekend optional

Hi Maya,

Thanks for applying to the Platform Engineer role — I’m Aditya from Talent at Redwood Inference. I’d love to set up a quick 20‑minute intro phone screen to learn more about your background and walk through the role.

A few DST-friendly options (I listed times in both PT/ET):
• Tue 9/14 — 9:00am PT / 12:00pm ET
• Tue 9/14 — 11:30am PT / 2:30pm ET
• Wed 9/15 — 7:30am PT / 10:30am ET (early slot)
• Sat 9/18 — 9:00am PT / 12:00pm ET (weekend option if weekdays are tight)

If none of those work, send me 2–3 times that do and your timezone and I’ll get something on the calendar. Please attach your latest resume if possible — I didn’t see one on your application.

I’ve CC’d Lauren (hiring manager) so she’s aware; we’ll plan for a quick phone screen and then a follow-up loop with the team if it’s a fit.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0186

Attachments: none

Thanks — excited to chat. I’m on Eastern Time (ET). The Tue/Wed options look good; my top picks are:
• Tue 9/14 — 12:00pm ET (your 9:00am PT)
• Wed 9/15 — 10:30am ET (your 7:30am PT)

Sat is doable but I prefer weekdays. I’ve attached my resume to this reply (Maya_Bloom_Resume.pdf).

Quick note: I have a standing call 1–2pm ET on Tuesdays, so anything before noon ET is best.

Best,
